meta.title: dsh-native
meta.description: dsh-native: a resident Rust worker handles command execution, sha256-guarded file IO, code indexing and search, session-log projection and resource sampling; the host stays a thin JSON-RPC, lane-scheduling, 7-route layer. The UI adds a pinned-header projection view with fuzzy filtering and a fixed 420 px detail pane, a Grafana-style monitor with lifetime min/max and sparklines, and the R-Native resource strip.
